n-k-k1-01.title: Amanqaku amane, ibango elinye
n-k-k1-01.goal: Gqiba ukuba ngawaphi amanqaku eklasi axhasa ngenene ibango ngeshedyuli, uze uthi yintoni eyahlukileyo kwinqaku elingaxhasiyo.
n-k-k1-01.material: Kwingxoxo yeklasi, uMinho wabhala: "저는 화요일 오후에 한국어 수업이 있어요." (Ndinayo iklasi yesiKorea ngoLwesibini emva kwemini.) UJina ufuna ukuhlola, ngoko ujonga amanqaku angezantsi. Inqaku bubungqina kuphela ukuba lihambelana nebango ngosuku, ixesha losuku nesifundo.
n-k-k1-01.thinking.1: Ukuhlola usuku, ixesha nesifundo enye ngenye
n-k-k1-01.prereq.1: Uyazi iintsuku zeveki ne-수업, 있어요/없어요, 오전/오후
n-k-k1-01.s.s1.prompt: Ngawaphi amanqaku axhasa ibango likaMinho? Khetha onke axhasayo.
n-k-k1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hlukanisa ibango libe ziziqwenga ezintathu: usuku, intsasa okanye emva kwemini, isifundo.
n-k-k1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola inqaku ngalinye ngokuchasene nazo zontathu iziqwenga, hayi leyo ibonakala inzima kuphela.
n-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.b: Usuku kuphela luhambelana. Ixesha losuku nesifundo ziyahluka, ngoko eli nqaku alithi nto ngeklasi yesiKorea emva kwemini.
n-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.c: Ixesha nesifundo ziyahambelana, kodwa usuku yi-수요일 (ngoLwesithathu), hayi i-화요일.
n-k-k1-01.s.s1.explain: A ixhasa ibango ngokupheleleyo (uLwesibini, emva kwemini, isiKorea). D ixhasa nayo kuba uLwesibini emva kwemini sesinye seentsuku ezimbini ezidwelisiweyo. B ihambelana nosuku kuphela, kwaye C ihambelana nayo yonke ngaphandle kosuku, ngoko akukho nanye bubungqina.
n-k-k1-01.s.s2.prompt: Khetha inqaku ELINYE elingaxhasiyo ibango (B okanye C). Thetha kwisivakalisi (isiNgesi sivumelekile) yintoni eyahlukileyo phakathi kwelo nqaku nebango.
n-k-k1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Beka inqaku nebango macala ngamacala uze ufunde ngeziqwenga.
n-k-k1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Thetha ukuba inqaku linantoni, kwaye ibango linantoni endaweni yoko.
n-k-k1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ndithe ibango linantoni noko inqaku linantoni endaweni yoko?
n-k-k1-01.s.s2.model.0: Inqaku C lilolwa ngoLwesithathu, kodwa ibango lithi uLwesibini, ngoko usuku luyahluka.
n-k-k1-01.s.s2.model.1: 수요일이에요. UMinho uthe 화요일, ngoko usuku aluhambelani.
n-k-k1-01.s.s2.model.2: Inowuthi B yiklasi yesiNgesi ekuseni, kodwa ibango lithetha ngeklasi yesiKorean emva kwemini.
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.prompt: Kamva uJina ufumana enye inowuthi: "화요일에는 한국어 수업이 없어요." Ibandakanya amagama 화요일 kunye 한국어 수업. Yenza ntoni kwibango?
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ngaba inowuthi iyavumelana nebango, okanye iyaphikisana?
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.hint.1: Buza ukuba inowuthi inokuba yinyani na ukuba ibango liyinyani.
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.o.a: Ayithi nto ngebango, kuba ayinikeli ixesha losuku.
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.r.a: Inowuthi ithetha ngosuku lonke lwangoLwesibini, ngoko ibandakanya emva kwemini.
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.o.b: Ixhasa ibango, kuba zombini 화요일 kunye 한국어 수업 ziyabonakala.
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.r.b: Amagama ahambelanayo awonelanga. 없어요 ithetha 'akukho', ngoko intsingiselo iyaphikisana.
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.o.c: Iphikisana nebango: inowuthi ithi akukho klasi yesiKorean ngoLwesibini.
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.o.d: Ibonisa kuphela ukuba iklasi ikwixesha elahlukileyo.
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.r.d: Inowuthi ithi akukho klasi yesiKorean ngoLwesibini kwaphela, hayi ixesha elahlukileyo.
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.explain: Ubungqina bugwetywa ngoko inowuthi ikuthethayo, hayi ngamagama ekuwo. 있어요 ithetha 'kukho', 없어요 ithetha 'akukho', ngoko le nowuthi iphikisana nebango.

n-k-k1-04.title: Amabali amabini ngomnxeba omnye
n-k-k1-04.goal: Fumana ukuba ngubani owenze ntoni ngeenxalenye zesivakalisi kwizivakalisi ezifutshane, uhlaziye isigqibo sakho xa isithethi sesibini siphikisana.
n-k-k1-04.material: Abafundi abathathu bathetha ngezolo. USujin, uMinsu noJiyeon ngabahlobo. 불렀어요 ithetha 'wabiza (umntu)'. Umntu othile wabiza omnye, kodwa aba bathathu abavumelani. 제가 ithetha 'mna' (owenza isenzo). 안 와서요 ithetha 'kuba akazanga'. Funda umyalezo ngamnye uphendule; umyalezo olandelayo uza kufika emva kokuphendula.
n-k-k1-04.thinking.1: Ukuhlaziya isigqibo xa kufika amabango amatsha
n-k-k1-04.prereq.1: Uyazi 이/가 kunye 을/를 njengezimaki ezilula, kunye 아니에요
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.prompt: Funda umyalezo ngamnye, ukhethe indlela yokufunda ebonakala inokwenzeka kakhulu, uze uqhubeke.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.hint.0: Fumana ukuba ngubani ophawulwe nge-이/가 kwaye ngubani nge-을/를 kwisivakalisi ngasinye.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ungasebenzisi ulandelelwano lwamagama kuphela; jonga izimaki ezincinci emva kwamagama.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.0.after: 지영이 nguye obizileyo, kwaye 민수를 nguye obizwe. Lo yingxelo kaSujin.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Lowo ne-이/가 (지영이) nguye obizayo. 민수를 ngumntu obizwayo.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: 수진 ngumntu ochaza ibali apha kuphela; akukho sivakalisi sithi 수진 ubize mntu.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Akukho nto kwisivakalisi ithi babizana; sinika igama lomntu omnye obizayo.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.1.after: 민수 (제가) uthi ubize 지영. Oko kuchaseneyo nebali likaSujin, ngoko omnye kubo uphosakele, okanye umnxeba wenzeke kabini.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Banika amagama abizi ahlukileyo: kumyalezo ka-수진 kubiza 지영, kumyalezo ka-민수 kubiza 민수.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: '아니에요' apha ithetha 'hayi, ayinjalo', kwaye isivakalisi esilandelayo sinika ibali lakhe.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Akukho nto ithi iintsuku ziyahluka; 민수 uphendula 수진 ngokuthe ngqo nge-'아니에요'.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Umyalezo ka-지영 uxhasa ibali likabani? (Ulandelelwano lwamagama luyahluka, kodwa jonga izimaki.)
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.2.after: 지영 uthi 제가 (mna) ndibize 민수를. Oko kuxhasa ibali likaSujin. Izithethi ezibini (수진, 지영) ngoku zithi 지영 ubize, kwaye 민수 yedwa uthi okuchaseneyo.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kwi-'민수를 제가 불렀어요', 민수를 ngumntu obizwayo kwaye 제가 nguye obizayo (지영 ngokwakhe).
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Akukho nalinye ibali, kuba ulandelelwano lwamagama lutshintshile.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ulandelelwano lwamagama aluyitshintshi indima. Izimaki 를 kunye 가 zisabonisa ukuba ngubani obize bani.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Amabali amabini anika iindima ezichaseneyo, ngoko umyalezo awunakuxhasa omabini.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.reflect: Imaki emva kwegama ibonisa indima: 이/가 iphawula lowo wenza isenzo, 을/를 iphawula lowo isenzo senziwa kuye. Ulandelelwano lwamagama lunokutshintsha, kodwa iindima ziyahlala zinjalo. Xa izithethi ezimbini zingavumelani, thelekisa ukuba ngubani obekwe kuyiphi indima.
n-k-k1-04.s.s2.prompt: Ngoku xelela umhlobo oko uJiyeon athi kwenzekile. Bhala isivakalisi esinye sesiKorean esinentlonipho: 지영 ubize 민수. Beka 민수 kuqala kwisivakalisi ngeli xesha, usebenzise izimaki ezichanekileyo.
n-k-k1-04.s.s2.hint.0: Gqiba ukuba ngubani obizayo kwaye ngubani obizwayo, uze ukhethe imaki yegama ngalinye.
n-k-k1-04.s.s2.hint.1: Yeyiphi imaki ebonisa lowo ubizwayo? Beka elo gama ekuqaleni kwesivakalisi.
n-k-k1-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Liliphi igama elinegama 가/이 kwisivakalisi sam kwaye liliphi elino-를/을?
n-k-k1-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba iindima zahlala zinjalo nangona 민수 eza kuqala?

n-k-k1-02.title: Isishwankathelo esithetha kakhulu
n-k-k1-02.goal: Thelekisa ishwankathelo elifutshane nesaziso sokuqala, ufumane imigca etshintsha oko kuthethwayo, uze uyilungise.
n-k-k1-02.material:
Isaziso setrip yesikolo sisezantsi, silandelwa lishwankathelo lomnye umfundi lomhlobo ongekhoyo.

[Isaziso]
소풍 안내
- 날짜: 다음 주 금요일
- 장소: 한강 공원
- 점심: 집에서 가져와요.
- 물: 학교에서 줘요.
- 비가 오면: 학교에서 영화를 봐요.

[Ishwankathelo lomnye umfundi lisenyathelweni elilandelayo.]
n-k-k1-02.s.s1.prompt: Ishwankathelo ngelomhlobo ongekhoyo. Yimiphi imigca ethetha into eyahlukileyo kwisaziso? Khetha omnye wayo.
n-k-k1-02.s.s1.hint.0: Dlula kwishwankathelo umgca omnye ngexesha ufumane ibhulethi ehambelanayo kwisaziso.
n-k-k1-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kumgca ngamnye, buza: ngubani ophayo, phi, kwaye nini? Thelekisa ezo nkcukacha.
n-k-k1-02.s.s1.explain: Umgca wesi-3 nowesi-5 awuchanekanga. Isaziso sithi zisa isidlo sasemini ekhaya (집에서 가져와요), kwaye xa kunetha imvula iklasi ibukela ifilimu esikolweni (학교에서 영화를 봐요). Imigca yoku-1, owesi-2 nowesi-4 ihambelana nesaziso.
n-k-k1-02.s.s2.prompt: Phinda ubhale imigca yeshwankathelo eyayingachanekanga ukuze ihambelane nesaziso. Sebenzisa isiKorean.
n-k-k1-02.s.s2.hint.0: Fumana ibhulethi ehambelanayo kwisaziso kumgca ngamnye ongachanekanga uthelekise iinkcukacha.
n-k-k1-02.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala umgca ngamnye olungisiweyo njengesivakalisi esinye esifutshane, ukopa iinkcukacha kwisaziso.
n-k-k1-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba umgca wam wesidlo sasemini uthi ngubani ozisayo nokuba usuka phi?
n-k-k1-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba umgca wam wemvula uthi phi nokuba benza ntoni?
n-k-k1-02.s.s3.prompt: Umfundi ofuna ishwankathelo elifutshane ushiya umgca ngamanzi. Ngaba oko yimpazamo efana nemigca engachanekanga oyifumeneyo?
n-k-k1-02.s.s3.hint.0: Buza ukuba yintoni eyahlukileyo phakathi kokushiya inyani nokuthi inyani eyahlukileyo.
n-k-k1-02.s.s3.hint.1: Phinda ufunde umgca wamanzi weshwankathelo ngokuthelekisa nesaziso phambi kokugqiba.
n-k-k1-02.s.s3.o.a: Ewe, kuba ishwankathelo kufuneka liphinde yonke imigca yesaziso.
n-k-k1-02.s.s3.r.a: Ishwankathelo linokuba lifutshane kunesaziso. Ukushiya into akufani nokuyitshintsha.
n-k-k1-02.s.s3.o.b: Hayi. Ukushiya inkcukacha kwenza ishwankathelo libe lifutshane; kuphosakala kuphela xa lithi into eyahlukileyo.
n-k-k1-02.s.s3.r.c: Ukubaluleka akunamsebenzi apha. Umbuzo kukuba ishwankathelo lithi into esingayithiyo isaziso na.
n-k-k1-02.s.s3.o.d: Hayi, kuba umgca wamanzi wawusele ungomnye wemigca engachanekanga.
n-k-k1-02.s.s3.r.d: Umgca wamanzi wawuhambelana nesaziso; wawungengomnye wemigca engachanekanga.
n-k-k1-02.s.s3.explain: Ishwankathelo elifutshane elilungileyo linokuyeka iinkcukacha, kodwa akufuneki litshintshe. Imigca yesidlo sasemini nemvula ziyagqwethwa kuba zithi into eyahlukileyo kwisaziso; ukushiya umgca wamanzi kuphelisa inkcukacha kuphela.

n-k-k1-03.title: Ifilimu inokuqala ngeyiphi ixesha?
n-k-k1-03.goal: Fumana amaxesha amaninzi okuqala ifilimu ahlangabezana nazo zonke iimeko kumyalezo, kubandakanya imeko ecingelwayo kuphela.
n-k-k1-03.material:
UMinjun uthumela umyalezo emva kwesikolo:

"수업이 두 시에 끝나요. 같이 영화 봐요! 영화는 두 시간이에요. 극장은 학교 옆에 있어요. 영화가 끝나면 집까지 한 시간 걸려요. 저는 여섯 시까지 집에 가야 해요."

Kwesi sicelo, ixesha libhalwa njengeeyure zedesimali kwiwotshi yasemva kwemini: 2.5 ithetha 2:30 kwaye 3 ithetha 3:00 (onke amaxesha asemva kwemini). Sebenzisa kuphela iiyure ezipheleleyo nesiqingatha.
n-k-k1-03.prereq.1: Uyazi iiyure zewotshi yesiKorean (한 시, 두 시, ... 여섯 시) kunye 시간
n-k-k1-03.s.s1.prompt: Ithini '여섯 시까지 집에 가야 해요' ngexesha?
n-k-k1-03.s.s1.hint.1: Vavanya ukufunda kwakho ngamaxesha amabini okufika (nangaphambili nangasemva) ubone ukuba yeyiphi indlela yokufunda ewavumelayo.
n-k-k1-03.s.s1.o.a: Kufuneka aphume aye ekhaya ngentsimbi yesithandathu ncam.
n-k-k1-03.s.s1.o.b: Kufuneka abe sekhaya ngentsimbi yesithandathu ubuncinane.
n-k-k1-03.s.s1.r.c: Isivakalisi sithetha ngexesha amele abe sekhaya ngalo, hayi ngokuqala kwefilimu.
n-k-k1-03.s.s1.o.d: Kufuneka abe sekhaya emva kweyure yesithandathu.
n-k-k1-03.s.s1.r.d: Oko kuya kuba kuchaseneyo: ubuncinane endaweni yomda.
n-k-k1-03.s.s1.explain: '-까지' ibonisa isiphelo soluhlu: ukuya kutsho kwintsimbi yesithandathu. Ukufika ekhaya kwangoko kulungile, ukufika emva akulunganga.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.prompt: Fumana amaxesha ama-3 ahlukeneyo okuqala ifilimu asebenzayo. s = ixesha lokuqala kwefilimu.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.hint.0: Dwelisa yonke imeko kumyalezo ngamagama akho: umda wokuqala, ubude, uhambo, umhla wokugqibela.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha ixesha lokuqala, wongeze ubude befilimu, uze wongeze uhambo lokuya ekhaya, uthelekise nomhla wokugqibela.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.hint.2: Zama ixesha lokuqala eliyisiqingatha seyure emva kweli lokugqibela elisebenzileyo.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.fail.c0: Sebenzisa kuphela iyure epheleleyo okanye isiqingatha (umzekelo 3 okanye 3.5).
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.fail.c1: 수업이 두 시에 끝나요: ifilimu ayinakuqala phambi kokuphela kweklasi.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Yongeza ifilimu (iiyure ezi-2) nohambo lokuya ekhaya (iyure e-1): wayeza kufika emva kwesithandathu.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.explain: Ifilimu ithatha iiyure ezi-2 kwaye uhambo lokuya ekhaya luthatha iyure e-1, ngoko ixesha lokuqala kunye neeyure ezi-3 kufuneka libe ngu-6 ubuninzi. Iklasi iphela ngo-2, amaxesha anokwenzeka okuqala ngu-2, 2.5 no-3.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Chaza kwisivakalisi esinye (isiNgesi sivumelekile) ukuba kutheni ifilimu eqala ngo-3:30 ingasebenzi.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Yongeza ifilimu nendlela eya ekhaya, uqala ngo-3:30.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Thelekisa ixesha lokufika nomhla wokugqibela kumyalezo.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ndisebenzise uhambo lokuya ekhaya kwingqiqo yam?
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ndibonise isixa (ukuqala + ifilimu + uhambo) okanye ndathi wayeza kufika ekhaya emva kwexesha?
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.because.model.0: 3:30 kunye neeyure ezi-2 yi-5:30, kwaye uhambo lokuya ekhaya luthatha enye iyure e-1, ngoko ufika ekhaya ngo-6:30, emva kwesithandathu.

n-k-k1-05.title: Vavanya umthetho womnye umfundi
n-k-k1-05.goal: Vavanya umthetho ngokubanzi womnye umfundi ngokufumana owakho umzekelo ochasayo, ucacise indlela yokwahlula iimeko ezimbini.
n-k-k1-05.material:
UHana ufunda isiKorean. Ubhale kwincwadi yakhe:

"If a Korean sentence ends in -요, it is a question."

Ubone ezi zivakalisi kwincoko: "뭐 해요?", "어디 가요?" kunye "이거 얼마예요?" Nganye iphela nge-요 kwaye ngumbuzo. Ngoku uvavanya umthetho wakhe.
n-k-k1-05.prereq.1: Uyazi izivakalisi ezisisiseko ze-요 namagama ombuzo 뭐, 어디
n-k-k1-05.s.s1.prompt: Sesiphi isivakalisi esingezantsi esingumzekelo ochasayo, oko kukuthi, isivakalisi esiphela nge-요 kodwa asingombuzo?
n-k-k1-05.s.s1.hint.0: Umzekelo ochasayo kufuneka uphele nge-요 kwaye uphule umthetho.
n-k-k1-05.s.s1.hint.1: Funda intsingiselo yesivakalisi ngasinye, hayi isiphelo sasiko kuphela.
n-k-k1-05.s.s1.r.a: Ngumbuzo onegama elithi 뭐 (yintoni), ngoko uhambelana nomthetho kaHana.
n-k-k1-05.s.s1.r.b: Le yintetho, kodwa iphela nge-니다, hayi i-요, ngoko ayiphuli mthetho we-요.
n-k-k1-05.s.s1.r.d: Ngumbuzo onegama elithi 어디 (phi), ngoko uhambelana nomthetho kaHana.
n-k-k1-05.s.s1.explain: '저는 학생이에요.' ithetha 'ndingumfundi'. Iphela nge-요 kodwa yintetho. Umzekelo omnye ochasayo wanele ukubonisa ukuba umthetho ongokubanzi awuyonyani.
n-k-k1-05.s.s2.prompt: Bhala owakho umzekelo ochasayo: isivakalisi esinye sesiKorean ngosuku okanye ubomi BAKHO (ungasebenzisi isivakalisi esingasentla) esiphela nge-요 kwaye sixela into, singabuzi, singamemi.
n-k-k1-05.s.s2.hint.0: Cinga ngento oyenzayo, oyithandayo, okanye onayo, uyithethe ngentlonipho.
n-k-k1-05.s.s2.hint.1: Gqibezela isivakalisi sakho ngesiphelo esinentlonipho se-요 kodwa ungasebenzisi igama lombuzo.
n-k-k1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba isivakalisi sam sixela into kunokubuza?
n-k-k1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba isithethi sesiKorean sinokuphendula ngokuthi 'ndiyabona' kunokuba sinike impendulo?
n-k-k1-05.s.s3.prompt: Ngoko umphulaphuli okanye umfundi unokwahlula njani umbuzo kwintetho xa zombini ziphela nge-요? Nika izalathiso ezimbini (isiNgesi sivumelekile).
